datasets.garmin: Personal Garmin data as clean, typed views (one row per day or per activity). Start with daily_overview. Dates are local calendar dates. Synced from Garmin Connect 3x/day.
datasets.garmin_raw: Untouched Garmin Connect API responses (JSON column `payload`), one table per endpoint. Prefer the views in the `garmin` dataset for analysis.

columns.date: Calendar date (local time of the Garmin account)
columns.min_hr: Lowest heart rate of the day (bpm)
columns.avg_stress: Average stress level (0-100); NULL when Garmin had insufficient data
columns.max_stress: Maximum stress level (0-100); NULL when Garmin had insufficient data
columns.body_battery_high: Highest Body Battery of the day (0-100)
columns.body_battery_low: Lowest Body Battery of the day (0-100)
columns.body_battery_charged: Body Battery points charged during the day
columns.body_battery_drained: Body Battery points drained during the day
columns.intensity_minutes: Intensity minutes as Garmin counts them: moderate + 2 x vigorous
columns.awake_min: Awake time during the sleep window (minutes)
columns.sleep_quality: Garmin sleep score qualifier (e.g. POOR, FAIR, GOOD, EXCELLENT)
columns.hrv_status: Garmin HRV status (e.g. BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW, NONE)
columns.type: Activity type key (e.g. running, strength_training, road_biking)
columns.name: Activity name as shown in Garmin Connect
columns.avg_hr: Average heart rate during the activity (bpm)
columns.weight_kg: Body weight (kg); last weigh-in of the day
columns.activity_count: Number of activities recorded that day
columns.activity_types: Comma-separated activity types done that day

views.daily_health: One row per day: steps, heart rate, stress, Body Battery, calories, intensity minutes, floors.
views.sleep: One row per night (dated by wake-up day): sleep timing, stages and score. Sparse until a sleep-tracking device is worn overnight.
views.hrv: One row per night: overnight heart-rate variability. Sparse until a sleep-tracking device is worn overnight.
views.body_composition: One row per day with a weigh-in (smart scale or manual entry).
views.daily_overview: MAIN TABLE. One row per day joining daily_health, sleep, hrv, body_composition and per-day activity totals. Use this first for most questions.
